description: Ministry of National Policies and Economic Affairs - Order made to appoint 15.07.2016 as the date on which the Microfinance Act No. 06 of 2016 shall come into operation
categorisation: The gazette content announces the commencement date of the Micro Finance Act, No. 6 of 2016, which falls under the category of legal/regulatory matters. While it mentions a minister's name, the primary purpose is to bring a specific piece of legislation into operation, making it a statutory instrument notification rather than a government personnel or structural change.
